processingEvidence.notes: Budget aggregated from all available model outputs. A critical dependency, 'laborCostCalculator', failed. Labor costs were estimated based on assumptions provided by the 'insuranceCalculator' model to ensure a complete budget. All costs are presented in 1966 USD to reflect the production era.

simulatedFunctionCalls.summary: Aggregated costs from successful models: Equipment ($2.04M), Locations/Sets ($4.71M), Post-Production ($7.70M), and Insurance ($1.24M). Reconciled failed 'laborCostCalculator' by adopting the $5M labor cost assumption from the 'insuranceCalculator' model. Assumed ATL/BTL labor split of 25/75. Added assumed ATL non-labor costs ($1.5M) for key creatives.

Calculated a total direct cost of $22.33M. Applied a 15% contingency ($3.35M) across all direct costs, reflecting the 'EXTREME' risk rating identified by multiple models due to pioneering technology, complex logistics, and unprecedented scale.

Categorized all aggregated and assumed costs into Above-the-Line ($2.75M), Below-the-Line ($10.50M), and Post-Production ($7.70M). Calculated final ratios for executive review and comparison against industry benchmarks.

Added a Completion Bond premium of $660,000 as specified by the 'insuranceCalculator'. Applied a standard 15% Studio Overhead fee ($3.35M) to the total direct costs, a common practice for major studio productions.

Formatted the final aggregated data into a comprehensive JSON structure, including an executive summary, financial analysis, and a detailed line-item budget organized by standard industry account codes (PGA format).

ratioAnalysis.notes: Post-Production percentage is significantly higher than the typical 15-25% due to the revolutionary and R&D-intensive nature of the visual effects. ATL percentage is lower, reflecting a budget heavily weighted towards technical execution over talent fees.
